profile.summary: Hi there! I'm a software engineer based out of New York City.

honors.title: Dickey Center International Internship Award
honors.description: Received funding to go to Cape Town, South Africa and complete an internship at the Division of Geomatics at the University of Cape town.

honors.title: The Neukom Institute for Computational Science Travel Grant
honors.description:
"These grants, awarded to excellent and deserving proposals on a first-come-first-served basis, are available to students who will be presenting their research at conferences, workshops, or symposia."

Received funding for a research trip to Masvingo, Zimbabwe.
